title: Retrieve the Ring
description: The chest is in the brush, never opened by whoever ran her off the road. The ring is inside - gold band untouched, the setting worked clean and empty. Take it back to her.

objectives.description: Take the ring from the chest

notes: Soulstone touchpoint (docs/design/quest_web.md #3): the setting is empty, the gold untouched, and nothing in the text names what the stone was or who took it. Never explained, never flagged, gates nothing.
